gate: Historical v72 best native width must be in top2 in each order; fresh native confirmation required afterward. Historical ranks are exploratory reference only.

Native fixed shortlist of equal initialization cost

All legal drafted tokens verified; no untrained confidence decisions
Unchanged target parameter pointers and versions
Separate clean caches for AR and shared-engine role
limitations: Shared engine has maxwidth8 and adaptive verification overhead; timings may rank widths differently from native engines.
